source_description_html:
These Ohlins shocks feature precision machining on all componentry, allowing for a low friction, high performance design. The internals feature a nitrogen gas over an oil to manage rebound and compression. The wide range of preload adjustments allows you to soften or stiffen the ride, and can also accommodate many riders varying in weight.

Features:

  • Emulsion type shock absorber
  • STX single tube design
  • Built-in adjustable preload
  • Multiple spring rates available to accommodate a wide range of riders
  • Hard anodized
  • Nitrogen charged
  • Precision CNC-machined components
  • Low-friction piston rod
  • Low-friction eyelets
  • Serviceable and repairable
  • 36mm piston diameter
  • Includes preload adjuster tool
  • Sold as a pair

Spring Weights:

  • Light Duty recommended for individual rider weighing under 195lbs
  • Standard recommended for individual rider weighing 195lbs - 245lbs
  • Heavy Duty recommended for individual rider weighing over 245lbs
